Could not find compatible versions

Because g4 = 2.0.beta could not be found in rubygems repository @SOURCE@/ or installed locally
  and every version of g3 depends on g4 = 2.0.beta,
  g3 cannot be used.
Because g1 < 3.0 depends on g3 >= 2.0
  and g1 >= 3.0 depends on g3 ~> 1.0,
  g3 ~> 1.0 OR >= 2.0 is required.
Thus, version solving has failed.
